description:
Open the Liverpool Cancer iChart app and navigate to the cancer drug 'Regorafenib'. Systematically scroll through the 'Co-medications' list and create a text report listing ALL therapeutic categories shown (e.g., 'Analgesics', 'Anticoagulants', etc.). 

Save the report to '/sdcard/regorafenib_categories_report.txt' with the following format:

Cancer Drug: Regorafenib
Total Categories: [Number]

[Category 1]
[Category 2]
...

You must list every category shown in the app for Regorafenib.
